implementation: One atomically published kernel-lifetime native mutex;unpublished losing allocation alone is freed.
Actual CX probe/initialization and ZAP loading retain the shared normal-call mutex through original protocol continuations;release precedes session-gate unlock on returned paths.
Calls from a thread already holding the global gate are refused before session-lock entry;private session/raw callback checks require the actual global gate held.
Original raw statuses,interrupted-entry budgets,BUSY/WAITQ behavior and independent hardware grants remain unchanged. Watchdog/PSCI paths are not rerouted.
limitations: Participating native CX/ZAP CPU sequences only;remaining legacy direct SCM callers are not covered.
CPU serialization is not power/security/owner permission or proof that firmware returned. Existing whole-epoch grant remains mandatory and unimplemented by this gate.
next_action: Complete source-backed coordination of remaining applicable normal SCM entry paths and the real platform-owned power/security handoff;then supply the actual epoch producer to the prepared direct-ring caller. Do not replace the independent grant with this CPU gate or rerun CPU-only board tests.
